correctness.rationale: On F_p^* the phase matrix acts on multiplicative character chi by K_chi times chi^{-1}; the exceptional constant/zero block is [[1,sqrt(p-1)],[sqrt(p-1),K_1]]. Cyclotomic independence proves nonvanishing under a singleton fiber; a nonzero linear term has a unique nonzero or zero quadratic fiber. With a=0,b!=0 the t->-t symmetry and prime Fourier minor theorem give rank (p+1)/2. The 2x2 Gram trace/determinant and character sectors give the squared singular spectrum. Independent SVD checks covered 204 parameter cases p=3,5,7,11; the general proof relies on cyclotomic/character arguments.
